newsitem.title: USA: Baxter clears hurdle for acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Baxter clears hurdle for acquisition.

text.p: Baxter International Inc said Monday the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino antitrust act for its planned acquisition of Research Medical Inc has expired without a request for additional information.
The transaction remains subject to other customary closing conditions, including approval by Research Medical shareholders, who are expected to meet in February, medical products company Baxter said.
Research Medical specializes in products used in open-heart surgery.
Baxter said last week it would buy Research Medical for the equivalent of $23.50 a share in Baxter stock.
Baxter shares closed up 1/8 at 43-1/2 Monday. Research medical closed up 1/8 at 23-1/8.
